title: Another one like this — same-spec-ref regeneration
summary: One-click regenerate-this-question. Looks up the question's specRef in curriculumBank.lookupBySpecRef, picks a fresh exemplar (preferring one not already used), and inserts the new stem as a sibling section. Falls back to aiGenerateWorksheet with a pinned specRef when the bank only has one exemplar for that ref. Append-by-default with a 'Replace original' affordance so teachers can iterate without losing the worksheet's existing shape.
motivation: Dr Frost ('huge bank of question generators for creating custom homework and tests'); Save My Exams ('exam-style questions, organised by topic and difficulty… target specific areas'). Today the only regen surface is aiEditSection which calls the LLM end-to-end; teachers want a deterministic 'fresh question on the same skill' that uses the curriculum bank that already exists.

in: client/src/components/AnotherOneButton.tsx (new, ~80 LoC) — wire-in button on every question card (teacher view, .no-print)
client/src/lib/ai.ts — extend aiGenerateWorksheet signature with optional pinSpecRef? + excludeExemplarIds? (backwards compatible)
Targeted vitest covering: bank-hit happy path, bank-miss LLM-fallback path, exclude-list honoured, specRef preserved on the new section.
out: Question-bank-only mode (G2 always falls back to LLM if the bank cannot satisfy)
Multi-question 'another set' (handled by G6 predicted-paper builder)
Pupil-facing 'try again' button (covered by G1's wrong-answer card; G2 surface is teacher-only)

acceptance_criteria: Clicking the button on a question with a populated specRef returns a NEW question in <1s (bank-hit branch) or <5s (LLM fallback).
The new section shares the same specRef, AO and bloomLevel as the original (provenance carries over).
Stem text is different from the original by Levenshtein distance ≥30% of the shorter string's length.
When excludeExemplarIds is supplied, the returned section's metadata.questionProvenance.sourceExemplarId is NOT in the exclude list (or undefined when LLM-generated).
Repeated clicks build a chain — 5 clicks produce 5 distinct stems on the same specRef (when the bank has ≥5 exemplars).

Section ordering preserved: the new section is appended directly after the original; clicking 'Replace original' deletes the original and renumbers questions via the existing section-question-counts validator.

risk_register.risk: Bank has no exemplar for the specRef → fallback fires for every click → token cost
risk_register.mitigation: Cache the LLM-fallback result keyed by (specRef, excludeIds) for 1 hour in the existing generationCache (PR-9); subsequent clicks reuse.

risk_register.risk: Exclude-list grows unbounded as teacher clicks repeatedly
risk_register.mitigation: Cap at 20; after that, allow re-using earliest-excluded with a one-time 'Bank exhausted — variants will repeat' notice.

related: G1 — pupil auto-marking (G2's surface can be reused on the wrong-answer card)
G6 — predicted-paper builder (G6 calls anotherOneLikeThis in batch via the same exemplar lookup)
H11 — try-harder / try-easier (a tier-shifted variant of G2)
FEAT-PF1 — curriculum bank (the lookup surface G2 consumes)
